idea-plugin.name: Python Protocol Implementations
idea-plugin.description:
Shows which classes structurally satisfy a typing.Protocol without inheriting from it, the way GoLand shows implicit Go interface implementations.
  • Gutter icon on a Protocol: classes that implement it.
  • Gutter icon on a class: protocols it satisfies.
  • Callback protocols (only __call__): functions whose signature matches, and on a function the protocols it satisfies.
  • Go to Implementation (Ctrl+Alt+B) on a Protocol includes implicit implementers and matching functions.
Only the module of the class and the modules linked to it are searched, not libraries or other repos opened in the same project.
